title: Aoyagi Toya — Don't Let It End Yet〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We did very well again during today's event. I'm glad we were able to win.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We've been able to produce good results in every event lately. And I couldn't be more grateful to have such reliable teammates.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And people have been responding well to my song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito and the others telling me that it's good was a relief, but I feel much better knowing that the audience agrees.)

Aha, there he is.
Hey, we've been looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They're the team that battled against us.
From what I understand, they're also professional musicians...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hello.
Thank you for today, LLD.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
No, it was our pleasure!
More importantly, we've got a question.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Do you guys write your own tracks?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: We wanted to ask because we really liked what we heard. It was like you could really feel what the writer had been feeling, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually... I was the one who wrote that song.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
You?! Really...?!
But you're so young. That's staggering.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
I didn't make it completely on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I never would've been able to make it without the help of my teammates.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: I see... We were hoping to hear a little about your creative process. Mind if we picked your brain for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not at all. I'd also like to hear more about your team and your activities.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: So, how do you guys go about writing songs?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, in our case, we first like to come up with the song's overall concept.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, we try to come up with sounds that match it and refine it as best we can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we place a high priority on channeling our feelings into it.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Channeling your feelings, huh?
Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: May I ask how your team produces its songs?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: We usually start with a chord progression, then we accent it with instrumental sounds...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: This guy's always going out and buying these instruments the rest of us have never even heard of. Not only that, he'll play them just once or sometimes not at all...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
But that explains why your songs feel so unique compared to other artists. You're able to express things in ways that they can't.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Plus, your audience seemed to really enjoy your music... It's a clear indication to me that you understand your strengths.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Haha. You're so polite.
But it's true that we keep those kinds of things in mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I asked you more about what you do to accent your music as you just mentioned...?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
We also wanna ask you more about how you guys channel your feelings into your songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll try to provide answers as best I can.
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
That was a good discussion, Aoyagi.
I think we know what we want to do for our next song now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm glad to hear that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I learned quite a lot from our discussion. Thank you for telling me about how you practice and write songs as professionals.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: It was a stimulating conversation for us as well. Seeing talented young people like yourselves always serves as a good source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I appreciate the compliment.
Again, thank you for your time.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Haha. You really are polite.
And I have a feeling that the sky's the limit for your team. Anyway, thanks for chatting with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(...
I was a little surprised by them at first...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I feel like my horizons have broadened a little.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We've been competing against a wide variety of teams and artists as we practice to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Those experiences by themselves have been wonderful...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm always grateful whenever I receive these sorts of opportunities to learn new information and ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm sure that we'll be encountering and competing against more and more musicians in the future. And we'll get to keep experiencing new things.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We'll keep growing and keep broadening our horizons together...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm looking forward to it very much.
